title: sil shopping_user_remember — request

id.description: Replaces this row: only an id `shopping_user_read` or a keep answered, never made up. A new row has none.

kind.description: Reads what kind of row it is.

text.description: Reads what the buyer told about themselves, how they like to be served or their situation, as said, with what it means for their buys: one to three sentences, never a label. Its place is its reach: `product` holds on every ask (what they value, how they spend, how they like to be served), a node is its context there (their experience in it). Starts from it, never asks it again, and says it when it is used.

place.description: Places the row at the node the domain read gave, as its path; a wider node for a wider place, `product` for everywhere. A read by place answers it there and beneath.

gives_back.description: Says what the row gives the buyer back next time; said when it is kept.

source.description: `told`: the buyer said it. `agent`: the agent read it off the conversation.
